events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Rolling Stones frontman, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jagger's Energy
angles.copy: Still strutting on stage at 83! Mick Jagger's incredible energy is unmatched. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first music video ever played.

angles.name: MTV Revolution
angles.copy: 45 years since MTV changed music forever! Remember the first video ever played? 'Video Killed The Radio Star' kicked it all off.

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis' iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe', which was actually released on August 29, 1994, is celebrated today.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Still sounds as fresh as '94! Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' is a true Britpop classic. Which track takes you back?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an iconic moment in music history, opened on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. What an incredible moment in time!

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Elvis Presley in 1977; the King of Rock 'n' Roll would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today, 49 years since we lost the King. What's your all-time favourite Elvis song?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders defined an era. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Oasis and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment, solo or Oasis?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine', released as a single in 1971, is remembered today.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message. John Lennon's 'Imagine' continues to resonate decades on. What does it mean to you?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007? Shaken, not stirred, naturally.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?
